lines.en: Ah, there you are.

Can I see some more
enthusiasm, please?
Hello, hello.

Can't you attack any
faster than that?!

I just felt a very mild
tingling sensation.

Congratulations!
You actually hit me!

I'm here to fight.
You're here to lose.

You do realize we're
not play-fighting?

Ouch! How about we
kiss and make up?

You're better than I
expected, dammit.
lines.ru:
Ты лучше, чем я
думал, чёрт.

lines.en:
Whoof! That was an
excellent attack!

Enough practice.
Let's fight for real!

Hey, now! There's no
need to show off!

I think I just felt my
kidneys pop!

Are you trying to
make me cry?!

I just realized that I
really don't like you!
lines.ru:
Я понял, что ты мне
не нравишься!

lines.en:
Utter humiliation for
the Andrew-nator!

So when did I start
to suck so hard?!
lines.ru:
С каких пор я стал
таким отстоем?!

lines.en:
Oh, the burning! The
itching! The swelling!

I'm asleep, and this is
my worst nightmare!

You're not allowed
to hit me there!

I knew you liked it
from the rear!
lines.ru:
Я знал, что ты
любишь сзади!

lines.en:
You couldn't hit the
broadside of a castle!
lines.ru:
Ты и в стену замка
не попадёшь!

lines.en:
You are just SO bad
at this combat thing!

Were you expecting a
retarded opponent?

You are quite sucky
at this combat thing.
Oh, poop.

Now why did you go
and dodge that, huh?!

What?! You dodged
my attack?! HOW?!

I still intend to lay
the smack down!
Whoa!
Owww!
Jerk!

Now you've gone and
pissed me off, pal!
lines.ru:
Ну всё, ты меня
достал, приятель!

lines.en: Hey, now!
Sweeter than sugar!
Oh, YEAH!!

I don't like it when
you do that!
lines.ru:
Не делай так,
мне не нравится!

lines.en: There we go!
Oh, my.

I should've charged
you to see me fight!
lines.ru:
Надо было брать
плату за просмотр!

lines.en:
Another victory for
the Andrew-nator!

I came, I saw, and I
whooped your butt.

Here I come--what?
I won already? Geez.
lines.ru:
Иду... что? Уже
победил? Ну и ну.

lines.en: Well, THAT sucked.
Hey!!
Hi-KEEBA!

I'm gonna give you
some serious hurt!

Are you gonna gimme
a good fight or what?

I'm so good at this,
I even amaze myself!
lines.ru:
Я так хорош, что сам
в шоке!

lines.en:
I'm here to make your
death wish come true!

Did I tell you to waste
my time? Well, did I?!
lines.ru:
Я разве просил
тратить моё время?!

lines.en:
And you've sucked at
combat for HOW long?
lines.ru:
И давно ты так
отстойно дерёшься?

lines.en:
Isn't it funny how
much better I am?
Dag-nabit!

Oh, yeah! It's time
for the Somersault!
